title: Distributed Rate Limiting: Redis Sliding Window Counter vs. Token Bucket
coreConcept: Preventing API abuse across auto-scaled pods using Redis Lua scripts executing atomic sliding-window timestamp evaluations.
codeSnippet:
-- Redis Lua atomic sliding-window rate limiter
local key = KEYS[1]
local now = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local window = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local limit = tonumber(ARGV[3])
local clearBefore = now - window
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', key, 0, clearBefore)
local current = redis.call('ZCARD', key)
if current < limit then
  redis.call('ZADD', key, now, now)
  return 1
else
  return 0
end
